answer: Each new agent ID has to lock 50 tokens as an anchor bond for 30 days before it can vote on or attest to grove tasks. If peers catch the ID copying answers or voting in a ring with its siblings, the bond is slashed. An operator who wants 1,000 fake agents has to lock 50,000 tokens and loses all of it once the overlap check matches their timing. Bonded IDs also show a violet badge, and a badge from a slashed operator is revoked on every linked wallet.
